name: trigger_pipeline_stage
description: Autonomously executes a specific Pulse Vector pipeline stage (daily, weekly, monthly, brainteaser) with options for stages, dry_run, target_date, force-regeneration, and disabling TTS.

target_date.description: Optional target date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. '2026-11-10')

dry_run.description: If True, validates pipeline paths and dependencies without writing files or uploading

force.description: If True, force-regenerates existing slides and videos
